title: 7. Conditionals, Hedging र Hypothetical Reasoning
group: मोड्युल २ · Band 7.0+ Complex Structures र Range Booster
blocks: वास्तविकताको एउटा scale-को रूपमा चार वटा conditional, Task 2-मा सबैभन्दा महत्त्वपूर्ण first कि second भन्ने छनोट, conditional-का धेरैजसो गल्ती हटाउने एउटै नियम, र academic सावधानीका लागि hedging-को toolkit।

Conditional प्रयोग गरेर तपाईं सम्भावनाबारे तर्क गर्न सक्नुहुन्छ: कुनै कुरा सत्य भयो भने के हुन्छ, सत्य भएको भए के हुन्थ्यो, र विगत फरक भएको भए के हुने थियो। यो परिणाम (consequence) र अनुमान (hypothesis)-को grammar हो, र Task 2-मा यसको भूमिका मुख्य छ — किनकि त्यहाँ लगभग हरेक तर्क वास्तवमा लुकेको conditional नै हो: सरकारले X गर्‍यो भने Y हुनेछ। Conditional-को साथमा hedging पनि आउँछ, अर्थात् सावधानीको भाषा (may, tend to, it is likely that)। यसले तपाईंका दाबीलाई पूर्ण वा एकतर्फी सुनिन दिँदैन, र लेखनलाई नापिएको र academic बनाउँछ।

हरेक conditional-मा एउटा if-clause (शर्त) र एउटा main clause (नतिजा) हुन्छ। यिनको क्रम जस्तो पनि हुन सक्छ; if-clause पहिले आयो भने त्यसपछि comma राखिन्छ। If demand rises, prices increase. = Prices increase if demand rises. चार वटा standard conditional-बीचको फरक यी दुई clause-को tense pattern-मा मात्र हुन्छ, र हरेकले वास्तविकताको फरक मात्रा देखाउँछ।
If you heat ice, it melts.
If taxes rise, consumption will fall.
अवास्तविक वा हुन नसक्ने जस्तो वर्तमान/भविष्य
If I were rich, I would fund schools.
If they had invested, the crisis would have been avoided.

Table-लाई वास्तविकताको एउटा scale-को रूपमा पढ्नुहोस्: zero सधैँ सत्य हुन्छ, first वास्तवमै सम्भव हुन्छ, second कल्पना गरिएको वा हुन नसक्ने जस्तो हुन्छ, र third अहिले असम्भव हुन्छ, किनकि त्यो समय बितिसकेको छ। सही conditional छान्नु भनेको तपाईं आफ्नो दाबीलाई कति वास्तविक सुनाउन चाहनुहुन्छ भन्ने छान्नु हो।
Second conditional-मा “were” बारे एउटा कुरा: formal English-मा सबै subject-सँग were प्रयोग हुन्छ (“If the government were to act …”), र Writing-मा यही सुरक्षित छनोट हो।
7.3 First कि second: Task 2-मा सबैभन्दा महत्त्वपूर्ण छनोट
तपाईंका conditional-सम्बन्धी धेरैजसो गल्ती र छनोट अन्त्यमा first कि second भन्ने प्रश्नमै आएर टुङ्गिन्छन्, त्यसैले यो जोडीको राम्रोसँग अभ्यास गर्नुहोस्।
तपाईंले साँच्चै सम्भव ठान्नुभएको वास्तविक प्रस्तावका लागि first conditional प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। If the government invests in public transport, congestion will decrease.
Hypothetical कुरा वा कल्पनाको रूपमा राखिएको सुझावका लागि second conditional प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। If every citizen planted a tree, the city would be greener.
If the government will raise taxes, spending falls.
If the government raises taxes, spending will fall.
First conditional-को if-clause-मा present simple आउँछ, कहिल्यै “will” आउँदैन।
If I would be in charge, I would ban cars.
If I were in charge, I would ban cars.
Second conditional-को if-clause-मा past simple / “were” आउँछ, कहिल्यै “would” आउँदैन।
Conditional-का धेरैजसो गल्ती हटाउने एउटै नियम

If-clause-मा कहिल्यै “will” वा “would” नराख्नुहोस्। “Will” र “would”-को ठाउँ result clause-मा मात्र हो। If-clause-लाई simple/past tense-मा राख्नुहोस् — एकै चालमा conditional-को सबैभन्दा common गल्ती हट्छ।
दुई वटा advanced तरिका स्वाभाविक रूपमा मिल्दा तपाईंको range बढाउँछन्:
Mixed conditional: विगतको शर्त, वर्तमानको नतिजा। If they had planned better (past), the city would not be so congested now (present).
Inverted conditional (formal, “if” हट्छ): Had the government acted sooner, the crisis would have been avoided. = If the government had acted sooner … (Inversion पूरा रूपमा Chapter 8-मा पढ्नुहुनेछ।)
यिनलाई एक पटक, सही तरिकाले, प्रभाव पार्नका लागि प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। जबरजस्ती घुसाइएको mixed conditional सफा standard conditional भन्दा नराम्रो हुन्छ।

Hedging भनेको कुनै दाबीलाई नरम बनाउनु हो, ताकि त्यो पूर्ण (absolute) statement नहोस्। Band 5-को लेखन बढाइचढाइ गरिएका दाबीले भरिएको हुन्छ (always, never, everyone, will definitely)। Band 8-को लेखनले आफ्ना दाबीलाई सीमित गर्छ, र अचम्मको कुरा, यसले ती दाबी झन् विश्वसनीय र academic सुनिन्छन्। तपाईंको लेखनको tone-लाई परिपक्व बनाउने यो सबैभन्दा छिटो तरिकामध्ये एक हो।
tend to, be likely to, appear to, seem to
often, generally, in many cases, to some extent, relatively
it is likely that, it appears that, there is a tendency for
many, some, a significant number of, the majority of
Junk food always causes obesity and will destroy public health.
Excessive consumption of junk food may contribute to obesity and could place a strain on public health.
“always causes” र “will destroy” बढाइचढाइ गरिएका छन्; “may contribute” र “could place a strain” नापिएका छन्।

Hedging कमजोरी वा अस्पष्टता होइन। यो तपाईं कति निश्चित हुनुहुन्छ भन्नेबारे सटीकता हो। “Immigration boosts the economy” यस्तो दाबी हो जुन तपाईं पूरै प्रमाणित गर्न सक्नुहुन्न; “Immigration can boost the economy” यस्तो दाबी हो जसको तपाईं बचाउ (defend) गर्न सक्नुहुन्छ।

दुई किसिमका गल्ती सबैभन्दा धेरै देखिन्छन्। पहिलो, conditional-मा tense चुहिनु (if-clause-मा will/would राख्नु)। दोस्रो, एकतर्फी पूर्ण दाबी लेख्ने बानी, जुन आंशिक रूपमा बंगाली निबन्ध शैलीमा चलेको बलियो दाबी गर्ने प्रवृत्तिबाट आउँछ।

गल्तीको प्रकार १ · if-clause-मा “will/would”।
✗ If the price will increase, demand will fall. / If governments would ban plastic, pollution would drop.
✓ If the price increases, demand will fall. / If governments banned plastic, pollution would drop.

गल्तीको प्रकार २ · सीमा नतोकिएका पूर्ण दाबी।
✗ Technology always improves our lives. / Every student prefers online classes.
✓ Technology generally improves our lives. / Many students appear to prefer online classes.
Conditional र hedging मिलेर Task 2-को परिपक्वता तय हुन्छ

Task 2-ले दुई कुरालाई पुरस्कृत गर्छ, र यो chapter-ले ती दुवै दिन्छ। Conditional-ले तपाईंलाई परिणामबारे तर्क गर्ने ढाँचा दिन्छ (“if this policy is adopted, then …”), जुन body paragraph-को मेरुदण्ड हो। Hedging-ले ती तर्कलाई कट्टर होइन, सोचविचार गरिएको सुनाउने tone दिन्छ। जुन script-मा सही second conditional र ठीक ठाउँमा राखिएको hedging सँगै हुन्छ, त्यो स्पष्ट रूपमा Band 7-plus जस्तो पढिन्छ, किनकि यसले grammatical range र rhetorical control दुवै देखाउँछ।

काम लाग्ने skill: Writing, Speaking
Task 2 (first conditional): If governments subsidise clean energy, the transition away from fossil fuels is likely to accelerate.
Task 2 (second + hedge): If education were entirely free, access might improve, though the burden on public finances would probably be considerable.
Speaking Part 3: It tends to depend on the context, but on the whole I'd say technology has made communication easier.
Chapter 7, र Module 2 यहीँ सकियो। अब Module 3 (Band 9.0 Masterclass), Chapter 8।

title: 7. Practice · Conditionals, Hedging र Hypothetical Reasoning
group: मोड्युल २ · Band 7.0+ Complex Structures र Range Booster
blocks: चार वटा conditional वास्तविकताको एउटा scale-मा मिलाइएका छन् — सधैँ-सत्यदेखि अब-सम्भव-छैनसम्म। सही conditional छान्नु भनेको तपाईंको दाबी कति वास्तविक सुनियोस् भन्ने छान्नु हो -- यसमा गल्ती भयो भने साँच्चैको सम्भावना पनि कोरा कल्पनाजस्तो सुनिन्छ, वा उल्टो।
**किन महत्त्वपूर्ण:** कुन conditional छान्नुहुन्छ भन्ने कुराले कुनै दाबीमा तपाईं कति विश्वस्त हुनुहुन्छ भन्ने देखाउँछ, र Task 2-को तर्कमा यो धेरै ठूलो कुरा हो।
वास्तविकताको scale-को रूपमा चार वटा conditional
**Zero** -- सामान्य सत्य / वैज्ञानिक तथ्य: If you heat ice, it melts.
**First** -- भविष्यको वास्तविक, हुन सक्ने सम्भावना: If taxes rise, consumption will fall.
**Second** -- कल्पना गरिएको वा हुन नसक्ने जस्तो: hypothetical वर्तमान/भविष्य।
**Third** -- अहिले असम्भव, किनकि त्यो समय बितिसकेको छ।
Scale-लाई क्रमैसँग पढ्नुहोस्: zero सधैँ सत्य, first वास्तवमै सम्भव, second कल्पना गरिएको, third असम्भव।
Formal English-मा second conditional-मा सबै subject-सँग **were** प्रयोग हुन्छ -- If the government were to act... -- र Writing-मा यही सुरक्षित छनोट हो।

blocks.title: Exercise 7.1 · Conditional फेरि लेख्ने
blocks.instructions: कोष्ठकभित्रको verb-लाई चाहिएको conditional अनुसार सही form-मा राख्नुहोस्, वा निर्देशनअनुसार वाक्य फेरि लेख्नुहोस्। If-clause-मा ध्यान दिनुहोस्: त्यहाँ “will” वा “would” हुँदैन।

items.prompt: If you heat water to 100 degrees, it ______ (boil).
accepted: boils
items.reason: Zero conditional: सामान्य सत्य, दुवै clause-मा present simple।

items.prompt: If the government reduces tuition fees, more students ______ (enrol).
accepted: will enrol

items.prompt: If I ______ (be) the mayor, I would ban private cars in the centre.
accepted: were

items.prompt: If they had listened to the experts, the disaster ______ (avoid).
accepted: would have been avoided
items.reason: Third conditional: past perfect + would have + past participle (passive)।

items.prompt: If the price of oil rises, transport costs ______ (increase).
accepted: will increase

items.prompt: If people recycled more, landfill sites ______ (fill) up less quickly.
accepted: would fill

items.prompt: If the company had invested in training, its staff ______ (be) more productive today. (mixed)
accepted: would be
items.reason: Mixed conditional: विगतको शर्त, वर्तमानको नतिजा।

items.prompt: Ice melts if the temperature ______ (rise) above zero.
accepted: rises

items.prompt: If more people ______ (use) public transport, the air would be cleaner.
accepted: used

items.prompt: If the trend continues, sea levels ______ (rise) by a metre this century.
accepted: will rise

items.prompt: If governments ______ (act) sooner, many species would not have become extinct.
accepted: had acted

items.prompt: If I were you, I ______ (choose) the science course.
accepted: would choose

items.prompt: Rewrite as an inverted conditional: If the authorities had responded quickly, lives would have been saved.
items.answer: Had the authorities responded quickly, lives would have been saved.
accepted: Had the authorities responded quickly, lives would have been saved.
items.reason: Inverted third conditional: “if” हटाउनुहोस्, “had”-लाई अगाडि ल्याउनुहोस्।

items.prompt: If children ______ (not / get) enough sleep, their concentration suffers.
accepted: do not get
don't get

items.prompt: If renewable energy became cheaper, developing countries ______ (adopt) it faster.
accepted: would adopt

blocks: Band 5-को लेखन पूर्ण दाबीले भरिएको हुन्छ -- always, never, everyone। Band 8-को लेखनले modal र tendency verb प्रयोग गरेर दाबीलाई hedge गर्छ, र अचम्मको कुरा, यसले दाबी झन् विश्वसनीय सुनिन्छ, कम आत्मविश्वासी होइन।
**किन महत्त्वपूर्ण:** Band 6-7-को लेखनबाट Band 8-को लेखनमा पुग्ने सबैभन्दा छिटो र सजिलै सिक्न सकिने upgrade-मध्ये एक hedging हो -- यो toolkit हो, जन्मजात प्रतिभा होइन।

Hedging-ले दाबीलाई नरम बनाउँछ, ताकि त्यो पूर्ण (absolute) statement नहोस्। "Immigration boosts the economy" यस्तो दाबी हो जुन तपाईं पूरै प्रमाणित गर्न सक्नुहुन्न; "Immigration can boost the economy" यस्तो दाबी हो जसको तपाईं बचाउ (defend) गर्न सक्नुहुन्छ।
**सम्भावना देखाउने modal verb:** may, might, could, can।
**प्रवृत्ति (tendency) देखाउने verb:** tend to, be likely to, appear to, seem to।
**Frequency/degree देखाउने adverb:** often, generally, in many cases, to some extent, relatively।
**व्यक्ति नतोकिएका (impersonal) frame:** it is often argued that, it could be said that।
Hedging कमजोरी वा अस्पष्टता होइन -- यो तपाईं वास्तवमा कति निश्चित हुनुहुन्छ भन्नेबारे सटीकता हो।

blocks.title: Exercise 7.2 · Hedging Upgrade अभ्यास
blocks.instructions: हरेक वाक्यमा दाबी बढाइचढाइ गरिएको छ। उपयुक्त hedging प्रयोग गरेर वाक्य फेरि लेख्नुहोस्, ताकि यो नापिएको र academic सुनियोस्।

items.prompt: Fast food always causes serious health problems.
items.answer: Fast food can cause serious health problems.
accepted: Fast food can cause serious health problems.
Fast food may cause serious health problems.
Fast food often causes serious health problems.

items.prompt: Everyone agrees that social media is harmful.
items.answer: Many people argue that social media can be harmful.
accepted: Many people argue that social media can be harmful.
It is often argued that social media can be harmful.
items.reason: सबैलाई समेट्ने “everyone … is”-को सट्टा hedged दाबी राख्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: Immigration will definitely boost the economy.
items.answer: Immigration is likely to boost the economy.
accepted: Immigration is likely to boost the economy.
Immigration can boost the economy.

items.prompt: Students who study abroad always become more independent.
items.answer: Students who study abroad tend to become more independent.
accepted: Students who study abroad tend to become more independent.

items.prompt: Technology never has any negative effects.
items.answer: Technology does not always have negative effects.
accepted: Technology does not always have negative effects.
Technology rarely has serious negative effects.

items.prompt: All young people prefer texting to phone calls.
items.answer: The majority of young people appear to prefer texting to phone calls.
accepted: The majority of young people appear to prefer texting to phone calls.
Many young people seem to prefer texting to phone calls.

items.prompt: Higher taxes will completely solve the problem of pollution.
items.answer: Higher taxes may help to reduce pollution.
accepted: Higher taxes may help to reduce pollution.
Higher taxes could help to reduce pollution.

items.prompt: Every developed country has excellent public services.
items.answer: Most developed countries tend to have good public services.
accepted: Most developed countries tend to have good public services.

items.prompt: Working from home is always more productive than working in an office.
items.answer: Working from home can be more productive than working in an office.
accepted: Working from home can be more productive than working in an office.

items.prompt: Tourism completely destroys local culture.
items.answer: Tourism may, to some extent, erode local culture.
accepted: Tourism may, to some extent, erode local culture.
Tourism can erode local culture to some extent.
